title: Make secondary mailbox wake race-safe
description: Send both a targeted IPI and SEV for every SMP mailbox publication and acknowledge the physical IPI unconditionally before running the callback.
reason: A secondary CPU could cross the global WFI-to-WFE transition while the sender selected only one wake mechanism.
problem_fixed: Windows secondary startup reset or hung immediately after the CPU1 mailbox was published.
reproduction: Boot the pre-fix eight-core image and observe that the log stops after 'Secondary 1 published' without the matching consume or guest-entry marker.
implementation: Changed the m1n1 SMP mailbox notification protocol only; no timer, vGIC, Mu, NVMe, display, input, or Windows change.
verification: Nested SMP Python suite 10/10 and complete nested C host suite passed.
hardware_result: All seven secondary mailboxes were consumed exactly once; CPUs 0 through 7 emitted CPU_ENTRY and remained live through the passive observation window.
notes: Do not infer guest death from the persistent proxy USB endpoint or launcher exit.

title: Record canonical J313 stability checkpoint
description: Pinned the hardware-tested EXP016 artifacts and documented the valid passive-observation contract.
reason: Earlier results mixed runtimes and a competing proxy observer caused an EL2 abort that was incorrectly attributable to the guest.
problem_fixed: Ambiguous assisted-boot results and unsafe use of a second proxy owner against a live guest.
reproduction: Launch a guest and attach hang_telemetry.py as a second proxy client; the old path reports an unhandled callback and can reset EL2.
implementation: Recorded exact m1n1 and Mu hashes; made direct telemetry attach fail closed; retained one proxy owner and passive log observation.
verification: Root Python suite 242/242 passed; EXP016 clean rerun remained alive for more than three minutes with no bugcheck, watchdog, exception, panic, or reset marker.
hardware_result: Canonical eight-core launch passed preflight and CPU_ENTRY for CPUs 0 through 7; operator desktop responsiveness remained explicitly unclaimed.
notes: Never attach a standalone observer while the assisted launcher owns asynchronous proxy callbacks.
